# Browser dependencies

Pinned, self-hosted distributions from the npm packages on jsDelivr:

- marked 18.0.13 — `lib/marked.umd.js` (MIT)
- DOMPurify 3.4.15 — `dist/purify.min.js` (Apache-2.0 or MPL-2.0)
- js-yaml 4.1.1 — `dist/js-yaml.min.js` (MIT)

Licenses are included alongside the scripts. Markdown output is sanitized before insertion into the page. No public-page runtime CDN dependency.
